suggested_fix: No fix required. The command union is zero-initialized with memset before use, so no uninitialized kernel stack data is sent to the DMUB firmware. The parameters are only copied into fixed-size scalar fields, and payload_bytes is set from sizeof() of the fixed payload struct. Nothing in the function uses an index or length that the caller controls. As defensive hardening, callers could check otg_inst and panel_inst against hardware limits, and the function could check abm/abm->ctx for NULL, but this file shows no exploitable flaw.
